data.name: 夜班护士模拟器
data.detailed_description:
GAME BACKGROUND: 
Welcome to Night Shift Nurse Simulator, a survival adventure game that blends nursing simulation with psychological horror elements. In this game, you play as a young nurse who takes a highly lucrative job at a remote, isolated hospital. However, as the days pass, you gradually uncover the eerie, supernatural phenomena lurking within its walls. When fear finally takes over and you decide to flee, you realize the way out has vanished without a trace... You have exactly 30 days: during this time, you must complete your nursing duties to earn enough salary to survive the ordeal, or give up the struggle and become the hospital's newest sacrifice.

Game-play Mechanics & Features: 

  • Nursing Job Simulation: Experience a variety of realistic nursing duties, including ward rounds, administering medication, and patient care. Every task presents a unique challenge; you must maintain your composure and manage your routines under extreme pressure.

  • Creeping Horror Elements: During your night shift patrols, unspeakable horrors hide in the hospital's dark corners. You will encounter random events, bizarre phenomena, and sudden, terrifying jumpscares. Stay highly alert and tread carefully to avoid falling victim to the grotesque anomalies.

  • Rich Dialogue & Lore: Uncover the hospital's dark mysteries through interactions with both patients and colleagues. Every conversation might yield crucial clues, helping you piece together the truth and understand the terrifying secrets hidden behind the facility.

  • Survival & Choices: Every decision you make carries weight. You will face life-or-death dilemmas, and your choices will directly dictate whether you survive to the very end to unveil the hospital's ultimate secret.

  • A Complete Story Arc: The game features a deep narrative driven by dialogue and triggered events. As the countdown ticks closer to day 30, the puzzle pieces will fall into place, but your ultimate fate rests entirely in your own hands.

Characters

  • The Protagonist (Nurse): A young woman with a resilient spirit. Burdened by her mother's severe illness and exorbitant medical bills, she is forced to accept a high-paying but highly suspicious job at this hospital. Despite the lucrative salary, she slowly realizes the deadly anomalies and hidden dangers within the facility.

  • The Head Nurse: Having worked at the hospital for years, she has witnessed countless anomalous events, yet her face has never aged a day. She seems entirely numb to the bizarre phenomena, showing neither surprise nor fear. She likely holds the keys to many of the hospital's dark secrets—perhaps even the truth behind the supernatural occurrences—but she remains strictly tight-lipped.

  • Zhao Changsheng: A mystic cultivator seeking immortality. In his bizarre pursuit of eternal life, a twist of fate landed him in the psychiatric ward. His unorthodox path has led him into a realm beyond ordinary human comprehension, granting him unfathomable abilities. Though he appears to be just another psychiatric patient, his true identity and power may exceed all imagination.

  • Zhang Wuji: A religious fanatic admitted to the hospital due to severe injuries. His sole possession is a peculiar, half-human-sized Buddha statue. This statue is far more than a mere religious artifact; it seems to pulsate with a mysterious power and might just be one of the root causes of the hospital's horrifying anomalies.
